name: Three Card Poker
description: Three Card Poker is a popular casino table game based on poker. Players compete against the dealer. It features two modes of play: Ante/Play (playing against the dealer) and Pair Plus (betting on the hand value alone). It is known for its speed and simplicity.

content.text: Three Card Poker is a popular casino table game based on poker. Players compete against the dealer. It features two modes of play: Ante/Play (playing against the dealer) and Pair Plus (betting on the hand value alone). It is known for its speed and simplicity.

Three Card Poker was invented in England in the mid 1990s by Derek Webb. It was originally called Casino Brag, inspired by 3-card Brag, and was adapted so players bet against the house rather than each other. The name Three Card Poker was adopted when the game was introduced to America; it is also known as Tri Poker. Derek Webb's Prime Table Games marketed it to casinos; in 1999 Shuffle Master (later SHFL Entertainment) acquired the rights.
